title: Effects of Realistic Job Previews on Multiple Organizational Outcomes
finding: A meta-analysis of 40 studies evaluated realistic job previews in relation to hiring outcomes, expectations, performance and turnover.
applicability: Use to inform a realistic role preview. Check whether recruits' expectations and early exits actually change in the local pilot.

title: Middle Managers, Personnel Turnover and Performance
finding: A randomized trial tested what happened when a retail chain gave store managers an explicit goal of reducing employee quits.
applicability: Use as a precedent for testing a manager-level retention goal. Retail results do not estimate the effect of engineering-manager coaching.

title: Hybrid working from home improves retention without damaging performance
finding: In a randomized experiment with 1,612 employees at a Chinese technology company, hybrid work reduced six-month attrition from 7.2% to 4.8%.
applicability: Relevant when testing hybrid work for roles that can be done remotely. The trial does not establish effects for on-site roles or a different schedule.
